name: lemur-renderer
description: Self-contained test harness for the lemur slide renderer (render/runtime.js + built decks). Lives outside the main project: the renderer and parser ship no dependencies — jsdom and puppeteer-core are dev-only, needed only to run these tests. Run from this folder: `npm install` then `npm test` (needs a system Chrome for the integration tests; set $CHROME if it is not on the default path). The Python parser/emitter tests are separate: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python` from the repo root.
